products.text:
Type: plaid flatweave runner rug
Use: covering a hallway or narrow floor; hallway, kitchen, bedroom
Style: farmhouse, coastal, contemporary
Materials: flat woven fibers, slightly textured weave
Colors: light cool gray-blue, warm beige, soft peach
Shape: long narrow runner, soft tartan plaid of crossing stripes, flat low profile, clean bound edges, light visual weight
Feel: soft, calm, homey
Goes with: warm wood floors, navy or white cabinetry, brass accents; farmhouse or coastal rooms

Type: round braided jute rug
Use: anchoring a seating or dining area; living room, dining room, bedroom
Style: bohemian, coastal, rustic
Materials: natural braided jute, off-white bands
Colors: warm natural tan, off-white
Shape: large circle, spiral braided texture from the center, double off-white border stripes near the edge, flat and earthy
Feel: natural, warm, relaxed
Goes with: light wood, rattan, white walls, linen textiles; coastal, boho or Scandinavian rooms

Type: geometric wool runner rug
Use: covering a hallway or bedside floor; hallway, bedroom, living room
Style: contemporary, bohemian, modern
Materials: wool, multicolored flecked weave
Colors: ivory, red, purple, flecks of blue and yellow
Shape: long narrow runner, concentric star and diamond chevron pattern, speckled texture, flat low pile, light visual weight
Feel: lively, playful, warm
Goes with: dark wood floors, white walls, colorful accents; eclectic or modern rooms

Type: large southwestern area rug
Use: anchoring a living or dining area; living room, dining room, bedroom
Style: traditional, bohemian, rustic
Materials: woven pile with vintage distressed finish
Colors: deep blue, rust orange, ivory, red accents
Shape: large rectangle, rows of medallion diamonds, small scattered motifs, patterned border, low pile, bold visual weight
Feel: rich, warm, earthy
Goes with: dark wood floors, leather, woven baskets, terracotta; bohemian or traditional rooms

Type: textured chevron area rug
Use: anchoring a living or dining area; living room, dining room, bedroom
Style: contemporary, modern, minimalist
Materials: soft cut and loop pile, carved texture
Colors: cool medium grey, light grey
Shape: oversized rectangle, tone-on-tone herringbone chevron rows in raised pile, plush texture, solid calm presence
Feel: soft, calm, cozy
Goes with: warm wood, white walls, green plants, wood chairs; modern or mid-century rooms

Type: Moroccan lattice area rug
Use: anchoring a seating area; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: contemporary, traditional, classic
Materials: low pile woven synthetic fibers
Colors: warm chocolate brown, cream
Shape: medium rectangle, bold quatrefoil trellis pattern, thin cream border, flat low pile, medium visual weight
Feel: warm, cozy, grounded
Goes with: taupe or brown sofas, cream ottomans, dark wood floors; traditional or transitional rooms

Type: floral traditional runner rug
Use: covering a hallway or bedside floor; hallway, bedroom, living room
Style: traditional, classic, bohemian
Materials: low pile woven fibers, distressed finish
Colors: dark blue, gold, cream, burgundy accents
Shape: long narrow runner, repeating floral kaleidoscope medallions, ornate scrolling motifs, thin blue border, low profile
Feel: rich, elegant, warm
Goes with: dark wood, brass, cream walls, jewel tones; traditional or eclectic rooms

Type: striped flatweave cotton rug
Use: covering a floor area; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: coastal, farmhouse, contemporary
Materials: flat woven cotton, heathered stripes, fringed ends
Colors: white, cobalt blue, heathered blue-grey
Shape: rectangle, wide horizontal stripes in solid and space-dyed blue, thin white lines, tassel fringe at both ends, light and flat
Feel: fresh, casual, breezy
Goes with: white walls, light wood, navy accents; coastal or farmhouse rooms

Type: modern color-block area rug
Use: anchoring a seating area; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: mid-century modern, retro, contemporary
Materials: tufted pile, carved texture
Colors: light grey, coral orange, dark brown, taupe
Shape: rectangle, curved stacked bands with rounded coral ends, thin dark stripes across the middle, low pile, bold graphic presence
Feel: playful, warm, graphic
Goes with: leather chairs, dark wood floors, black side tables; mid-century or retro rooms

Type: swirled pattern area rug
Use: anchoring a seating area; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: contemporary, modern, minimalist
Materials: low pile woven fibers, speckled texture
Colors: ivory, cool grey, charcoal
Shape: rectangle, all-over swirling spiral pattern in dashed grey lines, flat low pile, light airy look
Feel: calm, soft, airy
Goes with: grey upholstery, dark wood floors, woven baskets; modern or transitional rooms
